<script>
(() => {
  const SVG_NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";

  function el(tag, attrs = {}, parent = null) {
    const node = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, tag);
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(attrs)) {
      node.setAttribute(k, v);
    }
    if (parent) parent.appendChild(node);
    return node;
  }

  // Deterministic pseudo-random generator for clean, repeatable scenery
  function mulberry32(seed) {
    return function() {
      let t = seed += 0x6D2B79F5;
      t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
      t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 1. PROCEDURAL SEAMLESS ANDEAN LANDSCAPE LAYERS
  // =========================================================================

  // Helper to create a seamless two-tile parallax layer of tile width W
  function createParallaxLayer(containerId, tileWidth, buildTileFn) {
    const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
    const tileA = el("g", {}, container);
    const tileB = el("g", { transform: `translate(${tileWidth}, 0)` }, container);
    buildTileFn(tileA, tileWidth);
    buildTileFn(tileB, tileWidth);
    return { container, tileA, tileB, tileWidth };
  }

  // --- Clouds ---
  const clouds = [];
  const cloudsContainer = document.getElementById("cloudsLayer");
  const cloudConfigs = [
    { x: 140, y: 112, s: 1.05, speed: 7.5, op: 0.85 },
    { x: 520, y: 84,  s: 0.82, speed: 5.5, op: 0.72 },
    { x: 860, y: 132, s: 1.15, speed: 9.0, op: 0.78 },
    { x: 1180, y: 92, s: 0.74, speed: 6.2, op: 0.68 },
    { x: 340, y: 185, s: 0.62, speed: 4.5, op: 0.55 }
  ];
  for (const c of cloudConfigs) {
    const g = el("g", { opacity: c.op }, cloudsContainer);
    el("path", {
      d: "M -95 16 C -112 16, -118 -2, -96 -8 C -92 -28, -64 -38, -42 -26 C -26 -46, 14 -48, 32 -26 C 54 -34, 82 -20, 84 -2 C 106 0, 108 16, 86 16 Z",
      fill: "url(#cloudGrad)"
    }, g);
    clouds.push({ ...c, el: g });
  }

  // --- Far Snow-Capped Andean Peaks ---
  const farMountains = createParallaxLayer("farMountainsLayer", 1600, (g) => {

  // Gait parameters: synchronized mathematically to ground speed for ZERO foot slide!
  const GROUND_Y = 562;

  // Solve 2-bone IK from root R to foot target T
  function solveIK(rx, ry, tx, ty, L1, L2, bendDir) {
    const dx = tx - rx;
    const dy = ty - ry;
    const maxD = L1 + L2 - 1.2;
    const minD = Math.abs(L1 - L2) + 4;
    const d = Math.max(minD, Math.min(maxD, Math.hypot(dx, dy)));

    const baseAngle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
    const cosA = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, (L1*L1 + d*d - L2*L2) / (2 * L1 * d)));
    const angleA = Math.acos(cosA);

    const upperAngle = baseAngle + bendDir * angleA;
    const jx = rx + Math.cos(upperAngle) * L1;
    const jy = ry + Math.sin(upperAngle) * L1;
    const lowerAngle = Math.atan2(ty - jy, tx - jx);

    return { jx, jy, upperAngle, lowerAngle };
  }

  // Update a single leg's SVG geometry from its joint coordinates
  function renderLeg(leg, rx, ry, fx, fy, swingLiftRatio, hoofTiltDeg) {
    const { jx, jy, upperAngle, lowerAngle } = solveIK(
      rx, ry, fx, fy, leg.L1, leg.L2, leg.bendDir
    );

    // Build fluffy upper leg shape aligned along R -> J
    const ux = Math.cos(upperAngle), uy = Math.sin(upperAngle);
    const nx = -uy, ny = ux; // perpendicular vector
    const topW = leg.parts.isBack ? 28 : 23;
    const midW = leg.parts.isBack ? 23 : 18;
    const botW = 12.5;

    // Fluffy scalloped thigh/shoulder contour
    const p1x = rx + nx * topW - ux * 10, p1y = ry + ny * topW - uy * 10;
    const p2x = rx - nx * topW - ux * 10, p2y = ry - ny * topW - uy * 10;
    const m1x = rx + ux * (leg.L1 * 0.52) + nx * midW;
    const m1y = ry + uy * (leg.L1 * 0.52) + ny * midW;
    const m2x = rx + ux * (leg.L1 * 0.52) - nx * midW;
    const m2y = ry + uy * (leg.L1 * 0.52) - ny * midW;
    const j1x = jx + nx * botW + ux * 6, j1y = jy + ny * botW + uy * 6;
    const j2x = jx - nx * botW + ux * 6, j2y = jy - ny * botW + uy * 6;

    // Slight fluffy scallop puff near knee/hock cuff
    const cuffX = jx + ux * 10, cuffY = jy + uy * 10;
    leg.parts.upperPath.setAttribute(
      "d",
      `M ${p1x.toFixed(1)} ${p1y.toFixed(1)}
       Q ${m1x.toFixed(1)} ${m1y.toFixed(1)} ${j1x.toFixed(1)} ${j1y.toFixed(1)}
       Q ${cuffX.toFixed(1)} ${cuffY.toFixed(1)} ${j2x.toFixed(1)} ${j2y.toFixed(1)}
       Q ${m2x.toFixed(1)} ${m2y.toFixed(1)} ${p2x.toFixed(1)} ${p2y.toFixed(1)} Z`
    );

    // Subtle fleece curl detail on upper trouser
    const cStartX = rx + ux * (leg.L1 * 0.62) + nx * (botW * 0.65);
    const cStartY = ry + uy * (leg.L1 * 0.62) + ny * (botW * 0.65);
    const cCtrlX  = rx + ux * (leg.L1 * 0.78);
    const cCtrlY  = ry + uy * (leg.L1 * 0.78);
    const cEndX   = rx + ux * (leg.L1 * 0.62) - nx * (botW * 0.65);
    const cEndY   = ry + uy * (leg.L1 * 0.62) - ny * (botW * 0.65);
    leg.parts.woolCuff.setAttribute(
      "d",
      `M ${cStartX.toFixed(1)} ${cStartY.toFixed(1)} Q ${cCtrlX.toFixed(1)} ${cCtrlY.toFixed(1)} ${cEndX.toFixed(1)} ${cEndY.toFixed(1)}`
    );

    // Sleek tapered lower leg from J -> F
    const lx = Math.cos(lowerAngle), ly = Math.sin(lowerAngle);
    const lnx = -ly, lny = lx;
    const lTopW = 10.5;
    const lBotW = 6.6;

    const a1x = jx + lnx * lTopW - lx * 4, a1y = jy + lny * lTopW - ly * 4;
    const a2x = jx - lnx * lTopW - lx * 4, a2y = jy - lny * lTopW - ly * 4;
    const b1x = fx + lnx * lBotW - lx * 3, b1y = fy + lny * lBotW - ly * 3;
    const b2x = fx - lnx * lBotW - lx * 3, b2y = fy - lny * lBotW - ly * 3;

    leg.parts.lowerPath.setAttribute(
      "d",
      `M ${a1x.toFixed(1)} ${a1y.toFixed(1)}
       L ${b1x.toFixed(1)} ${b1y.toFixed(1)}

  // Pendulum physics state for the swaying woven neck tassel
  let tasselAngle = 0;

  // Natural blinking & ear twitch timers
  let nextBlinkTime = 2.6;
  let blinkProgress = -1;
  let nextEarTwitchTime = 3.8;
  let earTwitchProgress = -1;

  // Parallax scroll accumulators
  let scrollGround = 0;
  let scrollNearHills = 0;
  let scrollMidHills = 0;
  let scrollFarMtns = 0;

  // Main animation state
  let elapsed = 0;
  let lastTimestamp = null;

  function updateParallax(layer, offset) {
    const x = -(offset % layer.tileWidth);
    layer.tileA.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${x.toFixed(2)}, 0)`);
    layer.tileB.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${(x + layer.tileWidth).toFixed(2)}, 0)`);
  }

  function animate(timestamp) {
    if (lastTimestamp === null) lastTimestamp = timestamp;
    const dt = Math.min(0.05, (timestamp - lastTimestamp) / 1000);
    lastTimestamp = timestamp;
    elapsed += dt;

    // 1. Gait cycle phase [0, 1)
    const phase = (elapsed / CYCLE_DURATION) % 1;
    const tau = Math.PI * 2;

    // 2. Scroll parallax scenery smoothly (ground matches hoof stance speed exactly!)
    scrollGround    += GROUND_SPEED * dt;
    scrollNearHills += GROUND_SPEED * 0.24 * dt;
    scrollMidHills  += GROUND_SPEED * 0.11 * dt;
    scrollFarMtns   += GROUND_SPEED * 0.035 * dt;

    updateParallax(farMountains, scrollFarMtns);
    updateParallax(midHills, scrollMidHills);
    updateParallax(nearHills, scrollNearHills);
    updateParallax(pathDetails, scrollGround);
    updateParallax(fgGrass, scrollGround * 1.16); // slight foreground parallax depth

    // Drift clouds gently
    for (const c of clouds) {
      c.x -= c.speed * dt;
      if (c.x < -160) c.x = 1440;
      c.el.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${c.x.toFixed(1)}, ${c.y.toFixed(1)}) scale(${c.s})`);
    }

    // Gentle Andean breeze swaying foreground grass
    for (const tuft of swayTufts) {
      const ang = Math.sin(elapsed * 2.1 + tuft.phase) * tuft.amp + 1.5;
      tuft.el.setAttribute("transform", `rotate(${ang.toFixed(2)})`);
    }

    // Floating golden dust motes
    for (const m of motes) {
      m.x += m.vx * dt;
      m.y += (m.vy + Math.sin(elapsed * 1.6 + m.phase) * 5) * dt;
      if (m.x < -20) { m.x = 1300; m.y = 120 + Math.random() * 500; }
      if (m.y < 60) m.y = 640;
      if (m.y > 680) m.y = 80;
      const op = m.baseOp * (0.65 + 0.35 * Math.sin(elapsed * 2.4 + m.phase));
      m.el.setAttribute("cx", m.x.toFixed(1));
      m.el.setAttribute("cy", m.y.toFixed(1));
      m.el.setAttribute("opacity", op.toFixed(2));
    }

    // Update footstep dust puffs
    for (let i = dustPuffs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = dustPuffs[i];
      p.age += dt;
      if (p.age >= p.life) {
        p.el.remove();
        dustPuffs.splice(i, 1);
      } else {
        const t = p.age / p.life;
        p.x += p.vx * dt;
        p.y += p.vy * dt;
        p.r += 14 * dt;
        p.el.setAttribute("cx", p.x.toFixed(1));
        p.el.setAttribute("cy", p.y.toFixed(1));
        p.el.setAttribute("r", p.r.toFixed(1));
        p.el.setAttribute("opacity", ((1 - t) * 0.36).toFixed(2));
      }
    }

    // 3. Body vertical bob & gentle pitch (two soft bounces per full stride)
    const bodyBobY = Math.sin(phase * tau * 2 - 0.5) * 4.8;
    const bodyPitch = Math.sin(phase * tau * 2 + 0.45) * 1.55;
    bodyGroup.setAttribute(
      "transform",
      `translate(0, ${bodyBobY.toFixed(2)}) rotate(${bodyPitch.toFixed(2)}, 605, 385)`
    );

    // Shadow subtly breathes with body bob
    const shadowScale = 1 - bodyBobY * 0.008;
    shadowEl.setAttribute("rx", (145 * shadowScale).toFixed(1));
    shadowEl.setAttribute("opacity", (0.94 - bodyBobY * 0.012).toFixed(2));

    // 4. Long Neck graceful forward/back counterbalance + gentle Head stabilization
    const neckSway = Math.sin(phase * tau * 2 - 1.15) * 3.8 + Math.sin(phase * tau) * 1.1;
    neckGroup.setAttribute(
      "transform",
      `translate(698, 354) rotate(${neckSway.toFixed(2)})`
    );

    const headCounter = -neckSway * 0.62 + Math.sin(phase * tau * 2 - 2.1) * 1.6;
    headGroup.setAttribute(
      "transform",
      `translate(46, -134) rotate(${headCounter.toFixed(2)})`
    );

    // 5. Fluffy Tail happy rhythmic bounce
    const tailWag = Math.sin(phase * tau * 2 - 1.3) * 8.5 + Math.sin(phase * tau) * 3.0;
    tailGroup.setAttribute(
      "transform",
      `translate(468, 344) rotate(${tailWag.toFixed(2)})`
    );

    // 6. Swaying Andean Neck Tassels (damped spring pendulum driven by stride accel)
    const targetDrive = -neckSway * 1.4 - bodyBobY * 0.9 - 6; // slight breeze trailing back
    const springK = 42;
    const damping = 5.2;
    const accel = (targetDrive - tasselAngle) * springK - tasselVel * damping;
    tasselVel += accel * dt;
    tasselAngle += tasselVel * dt;
    tasselGroup.setAttribute(
      "transform",
      `translate(36, -3) rotate(${tasselAngle.toFixed(2)})`
    );

    // 7. Gentle Ear Bobbing & Occasional Curious Twitch
    let earTwitchOffset = 0;
    if (elapsed >= nextEarTwitchTime && earTwitchProgress < 0) {
      earTwitchProgress = 0;
    }
    if (earTwitchProgress >= 0) {
      earTwitchProgress += dt / 0.42;
      if (earTwitchProgress >= 1) {
        earTwitchProgress = -1;
        nextEarTwitchTime = elapsed + 3.4 + Math.random() * 4.2;
      } else {
        earTwitchOffset = Math.sin(earTwitchProgress * Math.PI * 2) * -10 * (1 - earTwitchProgress * 0.4);
      }
    }
    const earBob = Math.sin(phase * tau * 2 - 1.8) * 3.4;
    earFront.setAttribute("transform", `translate(-4, -22) rotate(${(earBob + earTwitchOffset).toFixed(2)})`);
    earBack.setAttribute("transform", `translate(8, -22) rotate(${(earBob * 0.75 - earTwitchOffset * 0.35).toFixed(2)})`);

    // 8. Soft Eye Blinking
    if (elapsed >= nextBlinkTime && blinkProgress < 0) {
      blinkProgress = 0;
    }
    if (blinkProgress >= 0) {
      blinkProgress += dt / 0.19;
      if (blinkProgress >= 1) {
        blinkProgress = -1;
        nextBlinkTime = elapsed + 2.8 + Math.random() * 3.4;
        eyelidCover.setAttribute("opacity", "0");
        eyelidLine.setAttribute("opacity", "0");
      } else {
        const closed = Math.sin(blinkProgress * Math.PI);
        const isClosed = closed > 0.55 ? 1 : 0;
        eyelidCover.setAttribute("opacity", isClosed ? "1" : (closed * 1.4).toFixed(2));
        eyelidLine.setAttribute("opacity", closed > 0.35 ? Math.min(1, closed * 1.3).toFixed(2) : "0");
      }
    }

    // 9. Update all 4 Legs with True 2-Bone IK & Zero-Slip Stance
    const pitchRad = bodyPitch * Math.PI / 180;
    const cosP = Math.cos(pitchRad);
    const sinP = Math.sin(pitchRad);

    for (const leg of legs) {
      const p = (phase + leg.phaseOffset) % 1;

      // Compute exact world-space hip/shoulder attachment accounting for body bob & pitch
      const dx0 = leg.rootBase.x - 605;
      const dy0 = leg.rootBase.y - 385;
      let rx = 605 + dx0 * cosP - dy0 * sinP;
      let ry = 385 + dx0 * sinP + dy0 * cosP + bodyBobY;

      // For near legs (inside alpacaBodyGroup), keep local coordinates relative to bodyGroup!
      // For far legs (outside alpacaBodyGroup), use world coordinates so they stay seamlessly attached!
      const isNear = !leg.parts.isFar;

      let footWorldX, footWorldY, liftRatio = 0, hoofTilt = 0;
      const centerFootX = leg.rootBase.x + leg.strideXShift;
      const halfStride = STRIDE_LENGTH * 0.5;

      if (p < STANCE_DUTY) {
        // STANCE PHASE: foot stays planted on ground and moves backward at exact GROUND_SPEED
        const s = p / STANCE_DUTY; // 0 -> 1
        footWorldX = centerFootX + halfStride - STRIDE_LENGTH * s;
        footWorldY = GROUND_Y + (leg.parts.isFar ? -5 : 0);
        // Gentle toe-off roll right at end of stance
        if (s > 0.84) {
          const toe = (s - 0.84) / 0.16;
          hoofTilt = toe * 22;
          footWorldY -= toe * 4;
        }
        // Spawn delicate sunlit dust puff when hoof plants
        if (!leg.prevPlanted) {
          spawnDustPuff(footWorldX, footWorldY + 3);
        }
        leg.prevPlanted = true;
      } else {
        // SWING PHASE: smooth lift and forward arc to next footfall
        const u = (p - STANCE_DUTY) / (1 - STANCE_DUTY); // 0 -> 1
        const easeX = 0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos(Math.PI * u);
        footWorldX = centerFootX - halfStride + STRIDE_LENGTH * easeX;

        liftRatio = Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.PI * u), 1.25);
        footWorldY = (GROUND_Y + (leg.parts.isFar ? -5 : 0)) - liftRatio * LIFT_HEIGHT;

        // Graceful hoof angle: points slightly down on lift, levels out before landing
        hoofTilt = Math.sin(Math.PI * (1 - u)) * 26 - Math.sin(Math.PI * u) * 8;
        leg.prevPlanted = false;
      }

      if (isNear) {
        // Transform world foot target back into alpacaBodyGroup's local coordinate space
        const fxRel = footWorldX - 605;
        const fyRel = footWorldY - bodyBobY - 385;
        const localFootX = 605 + fxRel * cosP + fyRel * sinP;
        const localFootY = 385 - fxRel * sinP + fyRel * cosP;
        renderLeg(leg, leg.rootBase.x, leg.rootBase.y, localFootX, localFootY, liftRatio, hoofTilt - bodyPitch);
      } else {
        renderLeg(leg, rx, ry, footWorldX, footWorldY, liftRatio, hoofTilt);
      }
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
})();
</script>
